props.title: El oficio se nota en el detalle

Cada cita se prepara como un pequeño ritual: diagnóstico, técnica y un acabado que encaja contigo.

paragraphs: Bourbon & Blade was born to bring back slow conversation and work made properly.
Every appointment is a small ritual: diagnosis, technique and a finish made for you.
